name: wipes
author: Takaro
description: Tells players about server wipes: a /wipe command with the last and next wipe, reminders before a scheduled wipe, and an announcement when the server is wiped.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Broadcast before a scheduled wipe. Each reminder is sent once per wipe. Placeholders: {timeLeft}, {time}, {wipeType}. Reminders are checked every 5 minutes by default, so one can be up to 5 minutes late, and one set less than 5 minutes before the wipe can be missed.

default.message: The next server wipe is in {timeLeft} ({time}).
The next server wipe is in {timeLeft} ({time}).

announcementMessage.title: Announcement
announcementMessage.description: Broadcast when the server is wiped. Placeholders: {wipeType}, {note}.
announcementMessage.default: The server has been wiped. A new cycle starts now, good luck!

wipe.helpText: Shows when the last wipe was and when the next one is

wipeAnnouncement.description: Broadcasts the announcement when the server is wiped

wipeReminder.description: Broadcasts the configured reminders before the next scheduled wipe
